This looks like an 18Ni maraging steel (grade 350 type, Ni 18, Mo 2.2, Ti 2.5, Al 0.1). Co is about 0, so it is a Co-free variant. Yield strengths for these steels in the dataset typically fall around 1400–2400 MPa. I estimated from that range and did not look up the recorded value.
